selection_policy.primary_demand: exactly one primary from canonical 7, determined by existing question answer.crux_move_ref and associated decisive learner act, not wording/option format
selection_policy.secondary_demands: record as supporting context without changing base cell
selection_policy.difficulty_band: derive D1..D4 from five difficulty components and evidence, not from sample cohort title or guessed percentage
selection_policy.status: PROPOSED until explicit independent academic and Owner decision ID and approved evidence hash
selection_policy.reclassify_after_reviewer: update teaching focus and review before any Core1A admission

question_specific_brief_required: original question ID and source hash only (protected words stay private) and truthfully stated source custody status
exact crux_move_ref resolving to existing answer.reasoning_route and primary/secondary demands
exact target mathematical concept, capability, prerequisite and assumed/observed learner knowledge with uncertainty
canonical QRT D-band, X/Y/Z/W learner-relative goals, hardest inferential bridge
two or more *meaningfully distinct* construction decisions only if needed by concept (not fixed number for parity)
stage representation that serves the demand or an explicit no-visual applicability waiver
authored changed-givens worked anchor, diagnostic hypothesis+discriminating probe, independent new-case exit
semantic checks H1 H2 H3 S1 S2 S3 P1 P2 P3 M1 M2 M3; justify N/A; no count scoring
separate reviewer classification decision and exact Owner QRT verdict before accepted/admitted flags
core1a_reuse_only_if: same mathematical concept/capability AND prerequisites are appropriate
same inferential decision that the learner must construct, not only same chapter or question format
independent authored worked/exit tasks target the question's actual demand at required depth
new question's W protected by preattempt support; route-to-concept and return context remain valid
reuse explicitly recorded and independently reviewed with no original question details embedded in shared lesson
fail_closed_on: missing crux or contradictory question-to-QRT demand
unjustified claim that one generic Core1A fits all 68

RETRIEVE.canonical_decisive_act: Reconstruct or select a fact, category, definition, property, unit, or condition.
RETRIEVE.canonical_visual_job: make discriminating features visible when representation helps; otherwise prefer a justified waiver to decoration

core1a.construction_decision: Rebuild the discriminating criterion and boundary for a category instead of memorising a surface label.
core1a.visual_job: Contrast cases sharing an appearance but differing in a defining feature; if drawing adds nothing, waive visual.
core1a.worked_anchor: Sort a fresh authored pair of near-neighbour examples and show the exact criterion.
core1a.independent_exit: Classify a newly authored boundary case and justify its criterion, not by recognition.
core1a.diagnosis: Probe surface-familiarity recall versus criterion-based classification.

EXPLAIN.canonical_decisive_act: Explain why a relation, mechanism, pattern, or result holds.
EXPLAIN.canonical_visual_job: show causal states, dependencies, or before/after relations without writing the conclusion

core1a.construction_decision: Connect a mechanism or warranted cause to the observed outcome, with direction and limits visible.
core1a.visual_job: Stage cause/dependency states or before/after; do not mark the protected explanation as already proven.
core1a.worked_anchor: Explain a new phenomenon from a named principle and state why each link holds.
core1a.independent_exit: Predict a change in outcome when one mechanism condition changes, then explain why.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish paraphrase of the outcome from an explanatory chain.

APPLY.canonical_decisive_act: Execute a known model, algorithm, relation, or procedure under the right conditions.
APPLY.canonical_visual_job: align givens with procedure variables or steps without carrying out the protected computation

core1a.construction_decision: Verify the procedure's applicability, map each datum to a variable and execute correctly.
core1a.visual_job: Show input-to-variable and ordered algorithm maps without computing the protected numeric result.
core1a.worked_anchor: Solve a new authored case with the correct substitutions and a reverse check.
core1a.independent_exit: Apply the same rule to new values or edge conditions and independently verify.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish valid arithmetic with a wrong formula/variable mapping from a simple arithmetic slip.

MODEL.canonical_decisive_act: Choose or formulate the governing model, law, variables, process, or strategy.
MODEL.canonical_visual_job: surface features that discriminate between candidate models without naming the winning model

core1a.construction_decision: Discriminate between plausible candidate models/strategies using assumptions, invariants and failure conditions.
core1a.visual_job: Reveal model-selection cues, counterexamples or comparison criteria without prematurely naming the winning model.
core1a.worked_anchor: Choose a governing model in a new authored situation and justify selection against an alternative.
core1a.independent_exit: Change an applicability condition and require the learner to select or reject a model before executing it.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish keyword-triggered model choice from evidence-based assumption comparison.

REPRESENT.canonical_decisive_act: Preserve meaning while translating between representations.
REPRESENT.canonical_visual_job: show source-to-target correspondences progressively while preserving the invariant without completing the final mapping

core1a.construction_decision: Identify the invariant and map entities or values between two representations without distortion.
core1a.visual_job: Progressive source→target map with matching quantity/sign/scale preserving the same mathematical meaning.
core1a.worked_anchor: Translate a novel authored expression/pair/table/diagram in both directions and compare invariants.
core1a.independent_exit: Translate a changed representation back, explain what remained unchanged.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish superficial diagram copying from preservation of quantities and relations.

SYNTHESIZE.canonical_decisive_act: Coordinate dependent ideas or steps where route selection is part of the difficulty.
SYNTHESIZE.canonical_visual_job: make dependencies, shared conditions, or state transitions visible without completing the route

core1a.construction_decision: Identify and order dependencies among two or more component moves and justify the bridge quantity.
core1a.visual_job: Stage a dependency graph or successive states without filling in the decisive missing link.
core1a.worked_anchor: Solve an authored case needing two interdependent principles and an explicit coordination decision.
core1a.independent_exit: Transfer to changed route ordering or a modified dependency, checking end-state consistency.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish independent fragment calculations from a valid integrated route.

JUSTIFY.canonical_decisive_act: Establish a conclusion from explicit warrants or evidence.
JUSTIFY.canonical_visual_job: show givens, evidence, and construction relationships without marking the conclusion as established

core1a.construction_decision: Move from a specific claim and its available evidence to a defensible warrant and conclusion.
core1a.visual_job: Make evidence, assumptions and inference boundaries visible without putting the final proof conclusion in the prompt.
core1a.worked_anchor: Prove a new authored claim with an explicit conditional warrant and boundary case.
core1a.independent_exit: Audit a new attempted justification using counterexample, converse check or independent derivation.
core1a.diagnosis: Distinguish pattern/sample-based assertion from a valid warrant or proof.

D1.canonical_protected_work: Leave one meaningful identification, relation, translation, or execution decision to the learner; support may make the surrounding route explicit.
D1.canonical_support_posture: Narrow the immediate operation if useful, but do not perform W.
D1.core1a_adaptation: One transparent construction and one independent decision; never pre-solve W.

D2.canonical_protected_work: Leave a short connection or choice plus its execution to the learner; support may identify relevant givens and a familiar principle.
D2.canonical_support_posture: Make the familiar pieces visible, but preserve the connection that makes them work together.
D2.core1a_adaptation: Connect two held elements or an idea and its new instantiation; learner must make the connection and complete the work.

D3.canonical_protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.canonical_support_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.core1a_adaptation: Expose component ideas while learner resolves a critical multi-step bridge and justifies ordering.

D4.canonical_protected_work: Leave the decisive model, strategy, synthesis, exception, or warrant itself to the learner; support may clarify constraints and invariants only.
D4.canonical_support_posture: Preserve the decisive abstraction or strategy choice even when additional optional support is available later.
D4.core1a_adaptation: Teach transfer constraints and counterexample thinking; preserve novel model/strategy/warrant abstraction without a solved clone.

candidate_q003.current_concept: Compare a consistent square-offset model over authored ordered pairs; identify one exception with a fixed residual.
candidate_q003.when_model: Teach assumption/model-family identification and compare a candidate square-offset rule against plausible alternatives before computing the residual; the learner must still decide the governing relation.
candidate_q003.when_apply: IF academic reviewer instead chooses APPLY: teach applying an explicitly supplied y=x²+k rule, input/output variable mapping and unchanged substitution, then independently verify; do NOT assume MODEL lesson is sufficient.
candidate_q003.when_represent: IF academic reviewer instead chooses REPRESENT: teach preservation of input/output order and invariant k across ordered pairs ↔ residual table ↔ graph, including reverse translation; not merely numerical substitution.
